# cto.new planned engineering contract

cto.new is the planned engineering and code-quality lane for IRS. It is issue/task driven, not a background repair carrier.

Require a genuine actionable repository issue intentionally handed to cto.new, verified live cto.new GitHub task/PR identity, a unique work fingerprint and a durable mutation lease before editing. A Kilo fallback requires durable ownership transfer and proof the previous writer is inactive.

cto.new must not choose dependency versions, weaken tests/security, rewrite protected controls under routine authority, merge its own PRs, use issues as programme ledgers, or compete with active Kilo work. If identity or task linkage cannot be proven, fail closed rather than guessing.
